title: wolfssl: verify hostname when peer verification is disabled
body:
Fixes #23475

When `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER` is disabled, wolfSSL does not run the domain check configured by `wolfSSL_check_domain_name()`. Check the peer certificate hostname after a successful handshake in this mode so `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST` remains independent. Keep the existing IP address check.

Validation: test 2118 was enabled for wolfSSL and run locally on Fedora AArch64 in an Alpine container with wolfSSL 5.8.2. It fails without the fix (error 52 instead of the expected certificate error 60), and passes with the fix. checksrc and git diff --check also pass.
